messages:
Leah CSM: FYI weekly health check picked up an unexpected spend cluster for Horizon (acct hrz-441). Spend guard raised an anomaly flag at 23:12 UTC. Can we triage? :mag:

Noah Ops: Saw that. Anomaly rule: hosted-api tokens/day > 3x rolling mean && error rate < 1% -> suspect legit heavy use not retries. Current daily tokens: 2.9M, baseline 750k. Pattern started ~21:30 UTC.

Dina Finance: Projection if sustained: ~3.6x monthly commit. Need to prep customer-facing billing options and an internal margin calc. Any idea if this is expected?

Kai Data: Quick breakdown: endpoint mix is 70% embeddings, 25% generate, 5% other. Median embedding size 1024 dims, payload count per call is high  looks like batch embedding of a large dataset. Top key is `sk-hrz-batch01`.

Ivy Eng: Could be their new vectorization job. Do we have recent onboarding notes? Leah?

Leah CSM: They mentioned a "search quality refresh" during onboarding last month, but said they'd run small batches. I asked their eng lead to confirm schedule.

alert-bot: Auto-created ticket CS-4628 at 23:14 UTC - "Horizon hosted spend anomaly: batch embedding surge". Assigned Leah, Noah. Link: <https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/CS-4628>

Noah Ops: Quick checks: origin IPs map to their cloud account, no 429 or 5xx spikes. Rate looks steady ~120 rps for embeddings endpoint. No retry signature.

Dina Finance: If it's planned we can convert to a one-off block purchase or a short-term increase to their reserved capacity. Need ETA from customer to avoid invoicing surprises. Also please capture which key + volume for billing ops.

Kai Data: Exported top-100 request samples (anonymized) to a temp S3 and shared link with the team. Shows large batch sizes and repeated document IDs  suggests reprocessing rather than deduped incremental.

Ivy Eng: Short-term mitigation options: 1) offer a temporary per-key soft quota and recommend chunking script (client-side) to reduce peak tokens, 2) enable server-side batching window to aggregate small embeddings into larger efficient requests (if they opt in). Which preferred?

Leah CSM: I'll propose both: immediate soft quota to prevent runaway, plus guided chunking script and offer an optional premium bulk-rate for this job. I'll wait for their reply.

Noah Ops: Implemented soft limit for `sk-hrz-batch01`: 600k tokens/day + 15 rps. Logged event and sent warning headers to requests exceeding 80% of cap.

Dina Finance: Preparing pricing options: 1) one-time block at 25% discount for extra tokens, 2) temporary overage rate, or 3) upgrade to dedicated reserved capacity at estimated break-even. Drafting numbers now.

Kai Data: Added a new alert rule: if embeddings tokens/day > 2M and >4x baseline, route to #customer-success-urgent + csv payload of top keys. Will kick in tomorrow.

Leah CSM: Customer confirmed: "yes, we kicked off a full dataset reindex at 21:00 UTC by mistake; expected small run. We'll pause and retry with chunked batches." They asked for guidance on chunk size.

Ivy Eng: Sent a short script and recommended chunk target: 200 records per request or ~100k tokens per minute. Also suggested exponential backoff on failures.

Noah Ops: After soft cap, hourly tokens dropped 68%. No evidence of retries. We'll keep the cap for 48h and coordinate with Leah before removing.

Dina Finance: Will send customer pricing options and mention the soft cap protection. Also adding an FAQ blurb about planned bulk runs to onboarding checklist so this doesn't repeat.

Leah CSM: Action list: 1) keep soft cap 48h (Noah), 2) finance outreach + block pricing (Dina), 3) provide chunking script + best practices (Ivy), 4) add onboarding note to checklist (Dina/Kai). Scheduling 20m wrap-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Thanks team. :tada:
